blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The University of Cebu Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue (UCLM) Junior Webmasters rallied from a 10-point deficit in the fourth quarter to edge the University of the Visayas (UV) Baby Lancers, 75-72, and preserve their unbeaten record in the Cesafi Season 26 high school basketball tournament. The Junior Webmasters improved to 6-0 (win-loss) to hold the No. 2 spot in the high school division standings, while the Baby Lancers slipped to 2-4 at seventh place. Their game took place on Sunday, October 18, at the UV Main Campus Gymnasium. Marky Mitch Goc-ong led UCLM with a game-high 20 points, five rebounds, […]...
